data.text:
A streamer paid me $8,000 for a GTA 6 server website I built in under 5 minutes.

He wanted a hub for his upcoming GTA 6 online server. Roleplay jobs. Application forms. Server rules. An FAQ. A Discord link. The kind of build an agency charges $8,000 for and ships in 3 weeks.

I opened Claude.

One prompt. I described the server, the jobs, the apply button, the whole layout. Hit send. Waited 2 minutes.

Out came the full site copy. Every page. Every section. Ready to paste.

Then I found an AI website builder. Dropped the prompt in. Pressed one white arrow.

The site loaded. Jobs, rules, FAQ, apply-now button, all live.

I hopped on a call and published it while he watched.

$8,000.

I didn’t write a line of code. I didn’t design a single page. I copied one prompt and pressed one button.

5 minutes. One prompt. $8,000. Next I’m doing it to every streamer alive.
